svg.title: Commits per month, split by AI co-author
svg.desc: Dec: 0 commits, 0 with an AI co-author; Jan: 36 commits, 4 with an AI co-author; Feb: 240 commits, 32 with an AI co-author; Mar: 154 commits, 59 with an AI co-author; Apr: 161 commits, 0 with an AI co-author; May: 99 commits, 0 with an AI co-author; Jun: 107 commits, 4 with an AI co-author; Jul: 189 commits, 14 with an AI co-author; Aug: 123 commits, 0 with an AI co-author; Sep: 20 commits, 0 with an AI co-author; Oct: 199 commits, 60 with an AI co-author; Nov: 756 commits, 498 with an AI co-author
